/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B -c 'import collections, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
print(\"instructions\", [str(p) for p in Path(\".\").rglob(\"AGENTS.md\")], [str(p) for p in Path(\".\").rglob(\"CLAUDE.md\")])
print(\"shallow\", subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"rev-parse\", \"--is-shallow-repository\"], text=True).strip())
print(\"8.1 tags\", subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"tag\", \"-l\", \"8.1.*\"], text=True).strip())
log = subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"log\", \"--no-merges\", \"--format=COMMIT:%h\", \"--name-only\", \"8.1.0..HEAD\"], text=True)
counts = collections.Counter()
co = collections.Counter()
total = 0
for block in log.split(\"COMMIT:\")[1:]:
    paths = sorted(set(p for p in block.splitlines()[1:] if p.startswith(\"src/click/\") and p.endswith(\".py\")))
    if paths:
        total += 1
        counts.update(paths)
        for i, p in enumerate(paths):
            for q in paths[i+1:]:
                co[(p, q)] += 1
print(\"nonmerge source commits 8.1.0..HEAD\", total)
print(\"file-touch counts\", counts.most_common())
print(\"cochanges\", co.most_common(8))'"

/bin/zsh -lc "PYTHONPATH=src python3 -B -c 'import click
from click.globals import pop_context
from click.shell_completion import _resolve_context
print(\"source\", click.__file__, \"version\", click.__version__)
cmd = click.Command(\"probe\")
a = click.Context(cmd, help_option_names=[\"--help-a\"])
b = click.Context(cmd, help_option_names=[\"--help-b\"])
print(\"help context A\", cmd.get_help_option(a).opts)
print(\"help context B\", cmd.get_help_option(b).opts)
ctx = click.Context(click.Command(\"cleanup\"))
def fail():
    raise RuntimeError(\"cleanup failed\")
ctx.call_on_close(fail)
try:
    with ctx:
        pass
except RuntimeError as e:
    print(\"close failure\", str(e), \"context still current\", click.get_current_context(silent=True) is ctx)
    pop_context()
seen=[]
def record(ctx, param, value):
    seen.append((param.name, value, ctx.resilient_parsing))
    return value
cmd = click.Command(\"complete\", params=[click.Option([\"--value\"], callback=record)])
_resolve_context(cmd, {}, \"complete\", [\"--value\", \"x\"])
print(\"completion parameter callbacks\", seen)
print(\"active context after probes\", click.get_current_context(silent=True))'"
